entries.en: to go on horseback; to ride (a horse)
entries.notes: 词头为连写『yr a cavallo』，R 栏存疑（sunggio/syggio）且声调号全污损，H 疑脱『马』字，据 L+M『seng be』暂定为骑马
R 栏 tou 与官话『去』对音不合，疑另有他字，未影响 L+H+M 互证
R 栏 joah 与『适』官话对音不合，疑另有他字；『适』古义『往』与词头 yr 互证

entries.zh: 吊唁、吊丧；前往埋葬死者
entries.en: to condole, attend a funeral; to go bury the dead

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑指被召唤而去
entries.en: possibly: to go at a summons/call (gloss doubtful)
entries.notes: L 词头残损（nofa/nra 存疑），H 于 申/神 之间无法定夺且两字义迥异，M sin 两读皆合，语义未定
H 栏『英』与词头 yr a pie（徒步）不合，疑误读或残字；据 L+M 释义为步行

entries.en: to go after/fetch something; to take along, carry
entries.notes: M 于 cia/ua 存疑；据 L『ir tras algo』与 H『提』释为去取物

entries.en: to go and return to a place; to go back and forth
entries.notes: L『boluer』存疑，但 H『往反』与 M『ong huan』明确互证往返义

entries.zh: 排人而去；众人依次前往
entries.en: for all to go in order; to go in file

entries.notes: H 于 谩/慢 之间存疑，义为慢进无碍

entries.en: to go together in company; to walk side by side
to have gone away, departed; to move, stir
entries.notes: L 疑为 haberse ido『已离去』；M 于 tay/tang 存疑，据 H『行动』释义
H 于 顿/转 之间存疑，据 L『ir a volver』释为转去（回去）

entries.en: to go away angry; to go and refuse to return
entries.notes: H 于 惜/忾、M 于 cay/cui 存疑；据 L 双释义（怒而去／去而不返）定夺

entries.en: to go after something to take/seize it; to pick up and carry
to go in haste, hurry along

entries.notes: M 于 tey/tue 存疑；据 L『ir a otra parte』与 H『过处』连读释为往他处
L『naio』疑为 navío 之误读；坐船义由 H/M 明确互证
